description: Airframe series 27; Marboré II engines; delivered to the FAS from Israel on 18 July 1975 and still reported airworthy as late as 1992. Given structural maintenance in August 2012 to prepare it for display in the Parque Infantil; San Salvador. Photo credit El Diario de Hoy.
